Running it
----------
simcity.tap is a cassette image for the Samsung SPC-1500 (built with
z88dk): the machine's own tape format, loaded by the IPL's "C: cassette
system", in the form MAME reads (one byte, 0 or 1, for each bit of the
tape).  In MAME:

    mame spc1500 -cass simcity.tap

1. At the IPL menu press C (cassette system): the IPL says it is looking
   for a program from CMT and to push the play button.
2. Start the tape with MAME's tape control (Play).  The IPL prints the
   program's name, loads it, and the program unpacks itself and starts.

The program takes about three and a half minutes to load.  It needs the
machine's 64 KB of RAM.

The game uses the X1-style 40 column mode: 320 x 200 pixels, three bit
planes (eight colours).  Sound is on the AY.

Saving and loading
------------------
Choose Save City or Load City (X or Esc opens the menu) and type a name,
up to 12 characters: capitals and lower case are different names.

Saving writes the city (about 9 KB) to the cassette in the machine's own
format, which takes about a minute and a half: press RECORD and PLAY,
then a key.  In MAME, give it a new file to record to ("mame spc1500
-cass city.wav") and start the recording from the tape control first.

Loading: press PLAY.  The game passes over any other files on the tape
until it finds the name.  To load in MAME, give it the recorded file
("-cass city.wav") and press Play.

Shift+Break together stops a tape operation.  The machine's motor relay
is turned on and off by the game.

This has been tried in MAME only, not on a real machine.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (with Shift: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (with Shift: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X, Esc          the game menu: save, load, budget, evaluation,
                  mini map, options, disasters, new city
  Backspace       when typing a name, deletes the last character
